dogecoin.text: I think it’s fair to say @elonmusk heavily influences #Dogecoin, too much power for a single person. Brace for impact.

#dogecoin is f**king dead. It did well before the social media exploits of @elonmusk. People are too impressionable and the volatility of doge has been due to people following social trends and various other events that trigger people to react. Crypto is volatile and convoluted.
